title: Level up with a cap
prompt: A member `max_health` at 100. Each level-up doubles it, but it can never pass 500, through a `level_up` helper. max_health_capped levels up four times and reports 500.
hints: level_up doubles max_health, then checks the cap; max_health_capped calls it four times and returns max_health.

docs.name: a * b
docs.what: Multiplies two numbers. * with a float keeps decimals.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.

solution:
var max_health = 100

func max_health_capped():
	level_up()
	level_up()
	level_up()
	level_up()
	return max_health

func level_up():
	max_health *= 2
	if max_health > 500:
		max_health = 500
